Elara and Zane: Trust Behind the Hidden Fortune | Complete Film

After betrayal on her wedding day, Elara chooses a new life with Zane. His concealed fortune and the decisions of both families turn their marriage into a conflict over trust, responsibility and what each partner has the right to know.

Nigerian animated drama on SussieNolly TV. This is a fictional story.

SERIES GUIDE
The complete film retells the same Elara and Zane story published in Parts 1–3; it is not a separate fourth story.
